avis.titre: Worth the splurge for magic in a jar!
avis.texte: I was excited to try this product because I'd heard so many great things about it but hadn't purchased it because of the price. After testing it, I can confidently say that for me, it's worth the splurge. I'm 43 with fair-to-light, very sensitive, dry skin and rosacea. I also live in a hot, dry climate where temperatures frequently exceed 100°,and heat & sweating can aggravate my rosacea. I've tried countless primers & setting sprays promising long-lasting, sweat-resistant wear, but I've never found one that kept my makeup looking fresh for more than a few hours without being overly matte & drying. This product impressed me immediately. It has a light citrus scent, but despite my sensitivity to fragrance, it caused no irritation & the scent quickly disappeared. The consistency is somewhat thick but feels luxurious rather than heavy. It absorbs quickly, leaves no stickiness or residue, & didn't cause any pilling. My skin felt soft, smooth & moisturized without feeling oily. My makeup applied beautifully over it, blending smoothly while still having enough grip to adhere well. I didn't experience the creasing or caking I sometimes get around my eyes from dry skin, & my skin felt hydrated enough that I could skip my usual extra moisturizing & eye-primer steps. I used only a few mists of setting spray so I could really test the primer's staying power. I was extremely impressed! My makeup stayed in place better than with any other primer I've tried. I've been using the Bobbi Brown Vitamin Enriched Face Base for over a month now, and I have the travel size. Even though I use it about five times a week, this little jar is going to last me a really long time because you only need a tiny amount. After that, my makeup applies absolutely beautifully and looks so smooth.
